headline: Chittilappilly Thomas Kochouseph files SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure with NSE
sum: Chittilappilly Thomas Kochouseph has filed a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or a change-of-control event at V-Guard Industries Limited, a Kerala-based electrical appliances manufacturer.
detail: V-Guard Industries, listed on NSE and BSE, manufactures and distributes electrical appliances including voltage stabilisers, inverters, water heaters and solar products, primarily in South India. The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations indicates Kochouseph has crossed a threshold triggering mandatory disclosure. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition route (market purchase, preferential allotment, or off-market), and the acquiror's intent (to acquire control or passive investment) are detailed in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange. No open offer announcement or competing bids have been publicly announced as of this filing date.
